# vendor/

`tetravox-module-sdk-1-0.8.0.tgz` is the SDK emitted by `node scripts/emit-module-sdk.mjs` from Tetravox branch
`main` at `9981f62` (`scene.tracts.scan` and `attachFile`, `scene.openFile`, `files.chooseFolder`, panel tabs). Tetravox 0.8.1 carries the same host API; this copy keeps the build from depending on a download.
